title: Gaussian receiver ranks certify 140,277 cheaper same-value reroute exclusions
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

On ToikY’s Gaussian word, all 5,674 arrivals are independent of the other arrivals and initial stock at their destination. Fixed outgoing and final demands have total local rank 5,660. Fourteen charts have one rational null direction each. At chart 595 the demands have rank seven, yet at least eight transmissions from its two fixed donor stocks are necessary even with acausal linear recoding.

A complete enumeration excludes 140,277 strictly cheaper nested alternate senders for a single unchanged transmitted value with the other donors fixed. The 171 full-stock survivors require a descendant of the replaced transfer. A directed depth-cut proof gives 9,527 against the word’s 9,639 paid grade units. The certificate yields a finite structural obstruction. It supplies no new signed κ or selection claim.

## Task and overlap

Refines `scalar-to-moment` to fixed-demand linear reroutes. Source is [ToikY’s #8072](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8072), head `75f7e1c44f48c43983016bcf8878c4d9e5e87c62`. [#8073](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8073) changes the ordinary suffix price. Both use the Gaussian word authenticated here. Metadata and the shared historical package preflight are pinned to `0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026`. This commit adds 13 files in one package.

## Validation

With CPython 3.12 and NumPy 1.26.4, ran `python3.12 -I -B research/p104-gaussian-receiver-rank/verify.py`. All seven finite check groups passed, including a second-prime signed control that distinguishes a genuine acyclic rescheduling from a descendant cycle. Separately reconstructed the graph from the authenticated #8072 package with `rebuild.py` and matched the full normalized graph digest `38d2b3a2311a9ba5fee091cc7aa204c7ed95651aec95d75184b2391df090cbfb`. Package metadata, committed bytes, file modes and pinned history passed locally. The proof gives the rational interpretation of the modular witnesses.

## Credit and open next question

ToikY supplied the allocation, Ali Romman the weighted producer and literal 48-call circuits, and SYLforge the ordinary circuit and physical replay. Predecessor notices and the Apache license are included. Clear1nsight used OpenAI Codex Astra and Terra agents for mathematical research, implementation, checking and writing. The next test is a change of both donor values and receiver decoding at a deficient chart, with legal chronological ownership and a fully repriced caller.
